name: Website Exposure Assessment
description: Scoped web asset: HEAD/GET metadata, TLS check and a security-header comparison. Reads results; a person approves and starts the checks.
legal_notes: Only for assets you own or hold written authorization to test. This workflow never sends a request itself: it reads authorization and observation records, and a person creates, approves and starts every exact plan in the Verification workspace. Findings are observations to verify, not proof of compromise.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: Verified headers and TLS observations with prioritised improvement suggestions, each linked to the stored response.
capability_gaps: This workflow is manual only and cannot send requests: checks run from the Verification workspace after a person approves the exact plan.
Not verified against third-party sites: every check was exercised against local lab servers only.
instructions: Scoped web asset: HEAD/GET metadata, TLS check and a security-header comparison. Reads results; a person approves and starts the checks.

definition.name: Website Exposure Assessment
definition.description: Scoped web asset: HEAD/GET metadata, TLS check and a security-header comparison. Reads results; a person approves and starts the checks.

config.prompt: Confirm you own the asset or hold written authorization to test it, and that the authorization names the host, ports and checks. Consent from a person is not authorization for their domains.
Open Verification. Create a plan for the authorized web asset: one HTTP metadata check (HEAD) and one TLS handshake. Review the preview, approve the exact plan and start it.
Review each observation: confirm, mark false positive or accept the risk, with a reason. Header findings are improvement suggestions, not vulnerabilities.
